note: Per-arm search limits for the live lift campaign. Money, request, token, reasoning and timeout caps live only in broker-config.json and are read at run time (model client timeout = broker timeout + 30 s). The development set path and SHA-256 are read at run time from frozen_manifest (files['development.json'], next to the manifest); holdout is never loaded. Both configs, the prompts, the seed, the frozen hashes and first-prompt.sha256 are covered by the approval hash (python -m integrations.lift_backends approval-hash).
evaluation: staged: GEPA minibatch = 3 parents (~66 instances); screen = 14 stratified parents (306 instances, ~5 s) for selection; full development (4588 instances, ~60 s) only when screen-valid and >= best screen score, and for every finalist
max_requests_note: Per-arm sub-caps of broker-config.json's shared max_requests (400), sized above each arm's observed call count (see autoresearch/TRACE-AUDIT-260925.md §1: 77/60/60/67) with headroom, summing to 300 of 400 so no single arm can drain the pool before a later arm starts (defect 2). Each arm gets its own ledger file (broker-ledger-gemini.<engine>.json) capped at min(its max_requests, what the shared pool has left after earlier arms' ledgers); the launcher refuses to start an arm whose sub-cap is 0 or whose remaining share of the shared pool is 0.
order_note: User decision 2026-09-24: GEPA and sequential control first, matched at 60 iterations; AdaEvolve and EvoX start only after GEPA shows one productive cycle. Total 210 contacts of the 332 ceiling; remainder reserved for finalist audit and reruns.
